dependencies.required_evidence: The terminal decision binds the exact 647,798,597-byte Endpoint428 store, five-byte wrapper, 647,798,592-byte WRT stream, and canonical raw corpus.
Reuse only its audited PP/RR, Q, and M byte-order parser semantics; do not inherit its q1 population, opportunity counts, program table, or activation authority.

contract.role: zero-credit Endpoint428 semantic-route population and coordinate tape

coordinate_law.source_wrt_coordinate: Zero-based coordinate of the WRT byte represented by the event, excluding the five-byte store wrapper.
coordinate_law.availability_wrt_coordinate: Earliest WRT coordinate at whose first coder decision the event classification and route are decoder-visible; it is never smaller than source_wrt_coordinate.
coordinate_law.physical_coder_decision_coordinate: Exactly availability_wrt_coordinate multiplied by eight, with overflow rejected.
coordinate_law.raw_decoded_before_after: Half-open canonical raw frontier emitted by an independent incremental decode of the source WRT byte. Zero-output control bytes have equal before and after coordinates.
coordinate_law.deferred_literals: A possible P or R delimiter is never predicted as a value byte. If the next byte proves it literal, an update-only record becomes available at the next WRT coordinate before any current-byte prediction.
coordinate_law.raw_identity: The incremental WRT decoder must consume the complete stream, reproduce exactly 1,000,000,000 canonical raw bytes, and match every emitted raw byte against the objective-bound corpus.

parser.alphabet: Stored Endpoint428 WRT bytes P/Q/M/R encode raw {{ / | / = / }} syntax under the frozen involutive remap.
parser.explicit_route: length-delimited tuple(template-name, 0x01, completed-explicit-key), available only after M is decoded
parser.positional_rule: A keyless field cannot be distinguished causally from an explicit key before its terminator. Positional descriptors are emitted only at field exit as nonpredictive audit events and produce no field_value_byte record.
parser.nested_rule: Nested PP/RR transitions use the WIKI-SCHEMA stack semantics. A nested template invalidates an outer name or key and pauses an outer value; nested bytes never update the outer route.
parser.overflow_rule: Depth or atom overflow sleeps until the causally matching delimiter returns the parser to valid state; overflowed descriptors never create predictive records.

record_abi.key_identity: 0 none, 1 explicit, 2 positional-audit; every other value is invalid
record_abi.ordering: Records are ordered by availability coordinate, then causal action order. Deferred updates precede any predictive event at the same availability coordinate.

descriptor_sidecar.role: Audit-only length-delimited explicit-route descriptors keyed by both 128-bit digests.
descriptor_sidecar.alias_rule: Any equal fingerprint or witness digest attached to unequal descriptor bytes invalidates the build.

build_and_verify: Build A and Build B execute in fresh processes over identical hash-bound store, raw corpus, and dictionary inputs.
Each build writes a tape, descriptor sidecar, and normalized summary without timestamps, paths chosen by the caller, or nondeterministic iteration.

The independent verifier reparses both binary ABIs, checks record ordering, bit-coordinate arithmetic, raw frontier bounds, event/flag/key consistency, descriptor aliases, declared hashes and byte counts, then requires byte-identical A/B artifacts.
Synthetic fixture mode is explicitly marked and can validate source only; it cannot satisfy the full-population gate.

resource_bounds.full_gate_concurrency: forbidden while the HORIZON retained-parent replay is active

activation_requirements: The scanner, verifier, runner, compiler, flags, input identities, ABI, schemas, commands, and output names are sealed before a full build.
The active HORIZON retained-parent process terminalizes before either complete semantic tape build begins.
Two guarded complete builds and independent verification pass before Fiber-CTS, Fiber-FOSSIL, FIBER-HORIZON, WIKI-LOOM, or ROUTE-MIDAS may consume the tape.
claim_boundary: This artifact is population infrastructure with zero archive and score authority.
The tape and sidecar are forbidden from the final codec package; a native codec must reproduce the parser and coordinates from decoded state.
Repeated parser identity proves no predictive information, retained-parent gain, arithmetic saving, inverse, package score, or Hutter Prize result.
No q1 semantic count, route, or parent probability transfers into this Endpoint428 identity.
